# tagging tagger

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:taggingTagger`](gmeow-taggingTagger.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/taggingTagger>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/tags`](../../slices/tags.md)

The agent who performed the tagging act. Non-functional: a tag may be co-asserted by multiple agents (e.g. a collaborative curation effort).
